conventions.cell_shape: Every assessed cell is {value, status, evidence}. NO BARE VALUES. A cell with status != MEASURED must never be cited as fact.

status_enum.MEASURED: read from the live artifact/API/source at a stated time; evidence names the call or file:line
status_enum.INFERRED: derived from measured facts but not directly observed; NON-ACTIONABLE per CLAUDE.md Rule 22
status_enum.UNMEASURED: not yet read; evidence names the exact call that would fill it
status_enum.NOT_MEASURABLE: no instrument can answer it from this artifact; evidence says why

clock_taxonomy.C1_write_clock: S3 LastModified - when WE wrote it. Says nothing about content.
clock_taxonomy.C2_partition_key: the date= segment. RUN date or DATA date - VARIES BY ARTIFACT AND NOTHING DECLARES IT.
clock_taxonomy.C3_data_vintage: the as-of INSIDE the file. The only real answer to 'what day is this about'.
clock_taxonomy.C4_roster_date: which day's membership was used. Only cottonwood has one today.

conventions.independence_rule: A provenance field is EVIDENCE only if it can DISAGREE with the partition key. A field we write from the key, or a vendor field that echoes the request, is DECORATIVE - record independent=false.
